wargearItems.name: Adrenal Glands
effects: The bearer increases its Initiative characteristic by 2.
The points cost for this upgrade is as follows:
5 points per model for models with a Toughness characteristic of 3 or lower
15 points per model for models with a Toughness characteristic of 4 or higher

  • 5 points per model for models with a Toughness characteristic of 3 or lower
  • 15 points per model for models with a Toughness characteristic of 4 or higher

wargearItems.name: Hardened Carapace
effects: The bearer increases its Wounds characteristic by 3.
The points cost for this upgrade is as follows:
10 points per model for models with a Toughness characteristic of 6 or lower
20 points per model for models with a Toughness characteristic of 7 or higher

wargearItems.name: Wings
effects: Models equipped with Wings:
Increase their Movement characteristic to 12"
Gain the Fly keyword
Gain the Deep Strike ability
Are equipped with Wing Barbs
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Models equipped with Wings:

  • Increase their Movement characteristic to 12"
  • Gain the Fly keyword
  • Gain the Deep Strike ability
  • Are equipped with Wing Barbs

wargearItems.name: Serpentine Bioform
effects: The bearer:
Increases its Movement characteristic to 9"
Increases its Initiative characteristic by 1
Gains the Deep Strike ability
Cannot be equipped with Wings
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
The bearer:

  • Increases its Movement characteristic to 9"
  • Increases its Initiative characteristic by 1
  • Gains the Deep Strike ability
  • Cannot be equipped with Wings

wargearItems.name: Neuroloids
effects: For each Neuroloid included with this unit, extend the Synapse Range of this unit by 6".
wargearItems.effectsHtml: For each Neuroloid included with this unit, extend the Synapse Range of this unit by 6".

wargearItems.name: Feeder Tendrils
effects: Each time this model destroys an enemy Infantry Character model with a Melee attack, increase its current number of Wounds by D3.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Each time this model destroys an enemy Infantry Character model with a Melee attack, increase its current number of Wounds by D3.

wargearItems.name: Warp Field
effects: Models equipped with a Warp Field gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability. Additionally, once per Battle, models equipped with a Warp Field can attempt to enhance their Warp Field. To do so, take a Psychic Test. If the test is passed, the bearer gains the Invulnerable Save 4+ ability until the end of the Battle Round.
wargearItems.effectsHtml: Models equipped with a Warp Field gain the Invulnerable Save 5+ ability. Additionally, once per Battle, models equipped with a Warp Field can attempt to enhance their Warp Field. To do so, take a Psychic Test. If the test is passed, the bearer gains the Invulnerable Save 4+ ability until the end of the Battle Round.

wargearItems.name: Spore Launcher
effects: When equipped with a Spore Launcher, this model can make a Ranged attack with that weapon by placing D3 Spore models at least 12" and up to 90" away from this model. Those Spore models then becomes their own Spores unit(s) that can be activated as described under the Spores unit profile. If you choose to place any of these Spore models within 6" horizontally and/or diagonally of each other, those Spore models become a single Spores unit.

wargearItems.name: Twin-linked
effects: Weapon gains the Twin-linked ability:
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1
The Twin-Linked upgrade doubles the points cost of the weapon being upgraded.
wargearItems.effectsHtml:
Weapon gains the Twin-linked ability:

  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 7 or less, increase the Attacks characteristic by 3
  • For weapons or Weapon Attack Profiles with a Strength characteristic of 8 or more, increase the Attacks characteristic by 1
